architecture_candidates.rationale: Declared 3.3 V host exceeds proposed DUT DC pin maximum VCC+0.4 V = 2.2 V at 1.8 V supply (and 2.35 V at 1.95 V). Absolute maximum is not an operating target.

proposed_logical_mapping.rationale: A3 to B3Y; DI is IO0 in multi-I/O modes
B4 to A4Y; DO is IO1 in multi-I/O modes

architecture_candidates.rationale: Three forward plus one reverse channel matches fixture standard SPI. Proposed VCCA=3.3 V host and VCCB=1.8 V DUT are within recommended rail ranges. Family-level candidate only; no package or complete electrical/timing design selected.

One device with all host signals on 3.3 V A ports and DUT on 1.8 V B ports has two shared-direction pairs. Available simultaneous splits are 4/0, 2/2, 0/4, not required 3/1. Swapping one route across voltage ports is not a solution. Rail ranges include both voltages but do not resolve topology.

decisions.text: All eleven document claims remain proposed and unreviewed. Hash identity does not authenticate manufacturer capture or identify physical parts; PDF text does not prove visual layout fidelity.

requirements.text: Restrict candidate to standard SPI with three host outputs and one host input; Dual/Quad operation requires a new direction architecture.
Resolve exact physical marking, suffix and package before assigning any physical DUT pins or translator footprint.
Design local 1.8 V supply and OE default-low control; retain default power off. Resolve current budget, sequencing, decoupling, protection and disabled-state behavior.
Complete threshold, output-drive, propagation-delay, setup/hold and load budget at actual rails and measured programmer behavior; do not infer SPI clock capability from application example.
